mapper.select: select id, session_id as sessionId, role, content, source_type as sourceType, source_ref as sourceRef, create_time as createTime from ai_message where session_id = #{sessionId} order by create_time asc, id asc

select * from ( select id, session_id as sessionId, role, content, source_type as sourceType, source_ref as sourceRef, create_time as createTime from ai_message where session_id = #{sessionId} order by create_time desc, id desc limit #{limit} ) t order by t.createTime asc, t.id asc
